entries.title: tours: every performance, with dates, venues and setlists
entries.body: the Ye archive now has a tours tab. every tour gets a summary, and every show is listed with its date, city, venue and the setlist where we have it.

entries.title: install wavernrs as an app
entries.body: add wavernrs to your home screen for a full-screen player with lock-screen controls, a proper offline screen, and a heads up when a new version is ready.

entries.title: a month by month Ye timeline
entries.body: scroll through Ye's career month by month, with a heatmap of every year so you can jump straight to the busiest months.

entries.title: the Ye discography, fully credited
entries.body: every album and song with producers, samples and credits, plus 30 second previews so you can check a track without leaving the page.

entries.title: song pages
entries.body: one page per song with every version, leak, live performance and edit of it in one place. follow a song to hear about new leaks.

entries.title: on this day in Ye history
entries.body: see what happened on today's date across the years: releases, leaks, shows and tweets. it's on the home page too.

entries.title: search finds the whole Ye archive
entries.body: search now returns Ye songs, albums, tweets and Yeezy pieces alongside comps, edits and editors. comps and song pages also got share buttons with proper link previews.

entries.title: listening parties go live
entries.body: start a listening party from any comp and listen together in sync, with live reactions, clickable links in chat and notifications that open the party.

entries.title: a livelier home page
entries.body: see who else is on the site right now, browse the archive by era straight from home, and see which other comps a song shows up on.

entries.title: archive: Top 150 and trackers
entries.body: a Top 150 tab and a trackers tab in the archive, a way to compare versions of a comp, listening stats, and swipe gestures on phones.
